● FAQ
### Questions clinics ask us
Does it use my clinic's own WhatsApp number?
Yes. OrbiDesk connects to your clinic's WhatsApp Business number so patients talk to "you," with the AI handling replies within seconds.
Will it sound robotic to my patients?
No. The AI is tuned for clinic conversations and your knowledge base, so it replies naturally and on-brand — in your patients' language.
Is my patient data safe?
Each clinic's data is kept separate, and staff see only their own clinic. We walk you through our privacy approach during your demo.
How long does setup take?
Setup is guided and needs no technical knowledge. You add your clinic details, doctors and hours, and we help you connect your WhatsApp Business number through Meta's official platform.

How OrbiDesk AI Works — Product | AI WhatsApp Receptionist for Clinics
● How it works
## From "hello" to booked — automatically, on WhatsApp
OrbiDesk AI works like a tireless front-desk receptionist that lives inside your clinic's WhatsApp. Here's exactly what happens every time a patient messages.
Book a Free Demo →
● Watch
### See OrbiDesk AI in action
Your browser can't play this video. Download it here .
Example conversation shown for illustration.
● The 24/7 loop
### Five steps that never sleep
Every patient conversation flows through the same reliable loop — no missed messages, no forgotten follow-ups.
💬 1. Message Patient texts your WhatsApp.
🤖 2. Reply AI answers in seconds.
📅 3. Book Appointment confirmed.
🔔 4. Remind Reminders sent automatically.
💸 5. Recover No-shows & leads re-engaged.
1
#### The patient messages your clinic
A patient sends a WhatsApp message to your clinic's own number — a new enquiry, a booking request, or a question about services. No app to download, no form to fill. Just the channel your patients already use every day.
Assalam o Alaikum, do you treat acne scars?
And what are your timings tomorrow?
Wa Alaikum Assalam! Yes, we offer acne-scar treatments. Tomorrow we're open 11 AM–8 PM. Would you like me to book you a consultation? 😊
2
#### The AI replies within seconds — in their language
OrbiDesk understands the question and responds in seconds, matching the patient's language and switching automatically if they change it mid-chat. It answers from your clinic's own knowledge base, so replies are accurate and on-brand — never a missed message, even at midnight.
3
#### It books the appointment for you
Once the patient is ready, the AI checks availability, offers real slots, and confirms the booking — capturing the patient's details in the process. Rescheduling and cancellations are handled the same effortless way.
📅
Appointment booked Consultation · Tomorrow, 4:30 PM
🔔
Reminder sent "See you tomorrow at 4:30 PM"
4
#### It reminds patients so they show up
OrbiDesk automatically sends reminders before each appointment to prevent no-shows and the revenue loss they cause. Patients can confirm, reschedule, or cancel right in the chat.
5
#### It recovers the revenue you'd otherwise lose
Missed appointments and unbooked enquiries don't just disappear. OrbiDesk follows up on missed visits, re-contacts patients who asked but didn't book, and reminds past patients when their next check-up is due.
＄
Missed visit followed up "Sorry we missed you. Shall I find a new time?"
● One place for everything
### Every conversation, booking & stat in one dashboard
Behind the scenes, your team sees every chat, appointment, patient, lead, and result inside a single Admin Dashboard — with your clinic knowledge, hours, and services all configurable in a few clicks.
🗂️
Conversations & Patients Every WhatsApp thread and patient record in one view.
📈
Analytics See what patients ask and how bookings trend.
⚙️
Configuration Set hours, services, and knowledge — no code.

## Tuned to your specialty
OrbiDesk AI adapts to the way your specific clinic works — the questions patients ask, the appointments they book, and the follow-ups that protect your revenue.
🦷 Dental
✨ Dermatology
💉 Cosmetic
🪞 Plastic Surgery

🦷 Dental clinics
#### Fill the chair, cut the no-shows
Dental patients message at all hours to ask about cleanings, braces, pain, and pricing. OrbiDesk answers within seconds, books the slot, and reminds them before the visit — so your chairs stay full.
Problem After-hours pain enquiries go unanswered until morning — and those patients often book elsewhere.
OrbiDesk AI Solution A reply within seconds, a booked appointment, and a reminder that prevents the no-show — automatically.
OrbiDesk AI example conversation
My tooth has been hurting since last night. Can I come in today?
Sorry to hear that. We have 5:30 PM today with the dentist. Shall I book it?
Yes please
Booked ✅ Today, 5:30 PM. See you then.
OrbiDesk AI example conversation
Do you treat acne scars with laser?
Yes. The doctor first checks your skin at a consultation. Thursday 4 PM or Saturday 12 PM?
Saturday
Done ✅ Saturday, 12 PM. I'll remind you a day before.
✨ Dermatology clinics
#### Turn skin-care enquiries into consultations
Derma clinics run on enquiries — acne, scars, laser, anti-ageing. OrbiDesk answers common questions from your knowledge base and turns interest into booked consultations before it goes cold.
Problem Enquiries about acne or skin treatments cool off before busy staff can reply.
OrbiDesk AI Solution Every enquiry answered the moment it lands and guided to a consultation.
💉 Cosmetic & aesthetic centers
#### High-value bookings, handled with care
Aesthetic patients expect fast, discreet, confident answers. OrbiDesk responds within seconds to enquiries about treatments and pricing, follows up on unbooked enquiries, and books consultations — while keeping every conversation on-brand.
Problem High-intent leads are lost to slow replies and a busy front desk.
OrbiDesk AI Solution Immediate, professional responses that protect premium bookings, day and night.
OrbiDesk AI example conversation
I'm interested in lip fillers but want to keep it private.
Of course. Your details stay with the clinic only. Would you like a consultation this week?
Friday evening?
Friday 6 PM is free. Shall I book it?
OrbiDesk AI example conversation
What is recovery like after rhinoplasty?
It differs for each person, so the surgeon explains it at your consultation. Want me to book one?
Yes, next week
Booked ✅ Tuesday, 3 PM with the surgeon.
🪞 Plastic surgery clinics
#### Guide high-consideration patients to consultation
Plastic-surgery patients research carefully and ask detailed questions about procedures, recovery, and pricing before they commit. OrbiDesk responds within seconds and discreetly, follows up if they don't book, and books the consultation — so high-value enquiries never slip away.
Problem Detailed procedure enquiries sit unanswered for hours; high-value leads drift to competitors.
OrbiDesk AI Solution Discreet, informative replies within seconds that guide patients toward a booked consultation.
🦵 Physiotherapy centers
#### Keep every session on the calendar
Physio depends on recurring sessions. OrbiDesk books the next appointment, sends reminders to keep patients on their plan, and re-engages anyone who drops off — protecting both outcomes and revenue.
Problem Patients skip sessions and quietly fall out of their treatment plan.
OrbiDesk AI Solution Automated reminders and follow-ups keep patients on plan and coming back.
OrbiDesk AI example conversation
I missed yesterday's session. Can I reschedule?
No problem. Wednesday 6 PM or Thursday 11 AM?
Thursday
Moved ✅ Thursday, 11 AM. Keep going, you're doing well!

## Page: https://orbideskai.com/about

About — OrbiDesk AI | AI WhatsApp Receptionist for Clinics
● About us
## Built to amplify clinic teams, not replace them
We started OrbiDesk AI after watching clinic receptionists struggle with dozens of WhatsApp messages while managing a full waiting room. We knew AI could help — not replace staff, but amplify them.
● Our values
### What we build around
🎯
Mission-Driven OrbiDesk AI helps clinics automate patient communication and daily operations — from automated booking to smart follow-ups — reducing missed appointments and keeping schedules full, without extra staff.
🛡️
Secure by Design Patient data is handled with a privacy-first approach: secure channels, controlled access permissions, and strict data isolation so only authorized clinic staff can view sensitive information.
🌐
Multilingual by Design OrbiDesk AI understands real clinic workflows and how patients actually interact. Whether they text in English, Urdu or Roman Urdu, the AI replies in the same language.
👥
Clinic-Centric Every feature is built around real clinic needs — booking, reminders, follow-ups, and workflow integration. OrbiDesk AI fits how your clinic already works, not the other way around.
🕐
Automation That Saves Time Reduce staff workload with automated scheduling, timely reminders, and no-show recovery — clinic automation that handles repetitive tasks so your team can focus on patient care.
💬
WhatsApp-First Communication Patients interact via WhatsApp — no app to install. A familiar, effortless experience for patients while automating your clinic's WhatsApp communication 24/7.
● Founder
### Meet the founder
#### Dr. Irfan Ullah Khan
Founder & CEO, OrbiDesk AI
- MBBS doctor
- Product architect of OrbiDesk AI
- Based in Pakistan
Dr. Irfan Ullah Khan is a medical doctor (MBBS) and the founder of OrbiDesk AI.
Practicing medicine showed him how much of a clinic's day goes into WhatsApp: patients asking about prices, timings and appointments, often after hours, while the front desk is busy with the people already in the room. Messages wait, and a patient who doesn't get a reply often books somewhere else.
He founded OrbiDesk AI to close that gap, and personally led it from the first idea to a live product: the AI receptionist that answers patients on WhatsApp in English, Urdu and Roman Urdu, the booking, reminder and follow-up system behind it, and the dashboard clinics use every day. Every workflow in OrbiDesk is designed around how clinics actually run, from a clinician's side of the desk.
His goal is simple: no patient message left unanswered, and more of the clinic's time for care.

## Page: https://orbideskai.com/faq

FAQ — OrbiDesk AI WhatsApp Receptionist for Clinics
● FAQ
## Everything you need to know about OrbiDesk AI
Clear answers about features, setup, security, and how OrbiDesk AI runs your clinic on WhatsApp — automatically.
### About OrbiDesk AI
What is OrbiDesk AI?
OrbiDesk AI is a WhatsApp AI receptionist built specifically for clinics. It handles patient conversations, books appointments, sends reminders and follows up on missed visits and enquiries, automatically, 24/7, directly inside WhatsApp. No new app for patients to download, and no extra reception staff to hire.
Who is OrbiDesk AI built for?
OrbiDesk AI is built for specialized clinics — dental clinics, dermatology clinics, aesthetic/cosmetic centers, plastic surgery clinics, and physiotherapy centers — from single-doctor practices to clinics with several doctors.
Is OrbiDesk AI a medical or diagnostic tool?
No. OrbiDesk AI is strictly a clinic communication and automation platform. It does not diagnose conditions, prescribe medication, or replace medical advice from a qualified clinician. All medical decisions remain with the clinic's doctors.
Which country and laws does OrbiDesk AI operate under?
OrbiDesk AI is a Pakistan-based platform and operates under Pakistani law. Billing is processed in PKR (Pakistani Rupees) and contracts are governed by Pakistan's commercial regulations.
### Features & Capabilities
What can the AI receptionist actually do on WhatsApp?
It replies to patient enquiries, books, reschedules and cancels appointments against real availability, sends reminders and preparation notes, checks in after treatment, follows up on missed visits and unbooked enquiries, reminds patients when a check-up is due, and alerts your team when your escalation rules are met.
Does OrbiDesk AI support multiple languages?
Yes. OrbiDesk AI replies in English, Urdu and Roman Urdu, in the same language the patient uses. It also understands voice notes.
How fast does the AI respond to patients?
Replies usually arrive in well under half a minute, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including nights, weekends and holidays.
Can the AI book appointments by itself?
Yes. OrbiDesk AI handles end-to-end booking: it checks doctor availability, matches the requested procedure to the correct duration, blocks the time slot, confirms with the patient, and writes the appointment to the clinic's dashboard automatically.
Can OrbiDesk AI recover missed appointments and no-shows?
Yes. When a visit is marked as missed, OrbiDesk sends the patient a friendly message offering a new time. It also reminds past patients when their next check-up is due.
### Setup, Onboarding & WhatsApp
How long does it take to get OrbiDesk AI live?
Setup is guided and needs no technical knowledge. You add your clinic details, doctors and hours, and we help you connect your WhatsApp Business number through Meta's official platform.
Do I need a WhatsApp Business account?
Yes. OrbiDesk AI connects through the official Meta WhatsApp Business Platform, and we guide you through connecting your number during onboarding.
Will my existing WhatsApp number change?
In most cases you can keep your clinic's existing number, so patients keep messaging the number they already know. We check your number's setup with you during onboarding.
Do my patients need to install any new app?
No. Patients simply message your clinic on WhatsApp the way they already do. OrbiDesk AI works invisibly behind that same number.
### Pricing & Billing
How much does OrbiDesk AI cost?
Pricing is tailored to your clinic's size and needs. Book a free demo and we'll walk you through a plan and quote that fits your clinic. Billing is in PKR (Pakistani Rupees).
Is there a free trial?
Instead of a free trial, we offer a free live demo so you can see exactly how OrbiDesk AI works for your clinic before you subscribe. You can book one on the Contact page.
How do I get a quote?
Book a demo on the Contact page or message us on WhatsApp. We'll understand your clinic's setup — specialty, number of doctors and patient volume — and share the right plan for you.
### Data Security & Privacy
Is my clinic and patient data secure with OrbiDesk AI?
Yes. Every clinic operates inside its own isolated tenant. Strict row-level security ensures no clinic can ever see, query, or access another clinic's patients, conversations, appointments, or staff. Authentication is enforced on every dashboard request.
Where is my data stored?
All clinic and patient data is stored on encrypted, access-controlled cloud infrastructure with role-based access. Only authorized users from your clinic (and you, the clinic admin) can read or modify your data.
Can I delete my patient data?
Yes. Clinic admins can delete a patient's records from the dashboard. When a clinic account is closed, all of that clinic's data is deleted.
### Comparison & Alternatives
How is OrbiDesk AI different from a regular WhatsApp chatbot?
Generic chatbots follow rigid scripts. OrbiDesk AI is an autonomous AI receptionist built for clinics: it knows your treatments and doctors, books against real availability, remembers patient history, and alerts your team when your rules say a person should step in.
How is OrbiDesk AI different from hiring a human receptionist?
A human receptionist works fixed hours, handles one chat at a time, takes leave, and costs a recurring salary. OrbiDesk AI works 24/7, handles many conversations at the same time, remembers each patient, and works alongside your team.
Why not just use ChatGPT or a generic AI tool?
Generic AI tools have no knowledge of your clinic's doctors, procedures, prices or schedules. They cannot book real appointments, cannot manage no-shows, and cannot integrate with WhatsApp Business. OrbiDesk AI is a turnkey clinic system, not a generic chat box.
### Support & Help
How do I get support if I have a problem?
You can reach the OrbiDesk AI team by email or WhatsApp from the Contact page. We help every clinic through onboarding.
Do you provide training for clinic staff?
Yes. Every onboarding includes a guided walkthrough of the dashboard and the AI settings.
What happens if the AI cannot answer a patient's question?
When a conversation meets the escalation rules you set in the dashboard, OrbiDesk AI alerts your chosen staff on WhatsApp with a summary so a person can step in.
#### Still have questions?
Our team is happy to walk you through OrbiDesk AI live and answer anything specific to your clinic.
Contact us →
